field_meaning.hi: NDVI से स्वास्थ्य मापा जाता है।

review_objections: Google: The Hindi transliteration misses the word 'Vegetation' (वेजिटेशन).

Alibaba: The Hindi meaning is incomplete and grammatically awkward ('NDVI se health is measured'). It should define NDVI as an index used to assess vegetation health/greenness, not just state that health is measured by it.
